extensionName.message: WPP Mask — Aliases and message protection

extensionDescription.message: Local group aliases and adjustable message blurring for WhatsApp Web.

protectChatHint.message: Blur history and keep recent messages readable.

historyHint.message: Scrolling into history blurs every message.

groupAliasesHint.message: Only you see the alias. The group name stays the same for everyone else.

aliasMatchingHint.message: Use the exact name. Chats with identical names share an alias. Search uses the original name.

aliasesEmpty.message: Your groups, with names that make sense to you.

statusSaveFailed.message: Could not save. Please try again.

statusMissingAlias.message: Enter the group name and alias.

statusReady.message: Ready to use on WhatsApp Web.

statusLoadFailed.message: Could not load settings. Reopen the extension.

localDataHint.message: Settings stay in this browser. No messages are sent.

visualProtectionHint.message: Blur is visual; it does not prevent access to content.
